* Cold Springs, Converse County. Seven miles southwest of Douglas, WY. Grass. Extreme fire behavior. 
Numerous residences threatened. 
 
Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 2). CIMT is also managing the 
Gold Mountain incident. Seven miles northwest of Lake City, CO. Timber, brush and grass. Active fire behavior 
with uphill runs, flanking and group torching. Numerous structures threatened. Evacuations, area, road and trail 
closures in effect. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, 
brush and timber. Active fire behavior with uphill runs, flanking and group torching. Energy infrastructure 
threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Weiser Knoll, Wind River/Bighorn Basin District, BLM. Thirteen miles southeast of Lander, WY. Grass, brush 
and timber. Extreme fire behavior with wind-driven runs, running and isolated torching. Residences threatened. 
Evacuations and area closures in effect. 
 
310, Garfield County. One mile east of Battlement Mesa, CO. Brush, timber and dormant brush. Minimal fire 
behavior with creeping and smoldering. Numerous residences and critical infrastructure threatened. 
 
Aspen Acres, Custer County. Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with 
backing and creeping. Communication infrastructure threatened. Area closures in effect. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior. Communication infrastructure threatened. 
 
* Bear Butte, South Dakota Division of Wildland Fire. Two miles east of Sturgis, SD. Grass. Extreme fire 
behavior with running. Residences threatened. Road closures in effect. 
 
Rio Blanco, San Juan NF, USFS. Ten miles south of Pagosa Springs, CO. Timber, brush and grass. Minimal 
fire behavior with flanking, backing and creeping. Numerous structures threatened. Road closures in effect.
